fact: The Council of Ministers chaired by President Tebboune on Sunday 20 September 2026 ordered a presidential decree to be drawn up on the secure digital interoperability plan between state bodies and institutions, defining the sectoral bodies' missions and representation under the High Commissioner for Digitalisation, and extended to the wilayas.

El Moudjahid reports that presidential decree 25-320, published in the Journal officiel of 30 December 2025, sets up a national data governance scheme with rules for data classification, cataloguing of sources and secure interoperability between administrations (article dated early January 2026, month precision).

fact: Presidential decree 25-320 of 30 December 2025, published in the Journal officiel, sets up the national data governance scheme, made of a data classification reference, a data-source cataloguing reference and the national interoperability system for secure exchange of data between public bodies.

The decree makes the national interoperability system the exclusive framework for data exchange between public institutions and administrations (art. 10), requires each body to classify and catalogue its data under the references to access it (art. 12), and puts the system's setup and administration under the Haut commissariat à la numérisation (art. 17), with the national information systems security council ruling on its operation (art. 14); national defence, security and judicial exchanges are excluded (art. 18).
The arrêté of 4 February 2026 cites executive decree no. 19-271 of 7 October 2019 on the national interoperability framework of information systems among its legal bases.
system: référentiel national d'interopérabilité des systèmes d'information
